findings.detail: Chart web 2.0.0 (revision 12 of Helm release shop/web) declares kubeVersion ">=1.19.0-0 <1.25.0-0" in Chart.yaml, which Kubernetes 1.25 does not satisfy. Helm refuses to install or upgrade a chart whose kubeVersion excludes the cluster version, so once the cluster runs 1.25 every helm upgrade of this release fails until it moves to a chart version that supports 1.25.
findings.remediation: upgrade the release to a chart version whose kubeVersion includes 1.25 before upgrading the cluster
findings.title: Helm release shop/web: chart web 2.0.0 requires Kubernetes ">=1.19.0-0 <1.25.0-0" (target 1.25)

findings.title: batch/v1beta1 CronJob removed in 1.25 (1 object)

findings.detail: Revision 7 of Helm release batch/jobs (chart jobs 1.4.0) stores a manifest with 1 object at APIs Kubernetes 1.25 does not serve: batch/v1beta1 CronJob (removed in 1.25; 1 object). Helm refuses to upgrade a release whose stored manifest uses APIs the cluster no longer serves.
findings.remediation: upgrade the release to a chart version that renders supported APIs (batch/v1 CronJob) before upgrading the cluster; if the cluster already stopped serving them, rewrite the stored manifest with the helm-mapkubeapis plugin first
findings.title: helm upgrade of release batch/jobs will fail: its manifest uses batch/v1beta1 CronJob

findings.remediation: upgrade the release to a chart version that renders supported APIs
